name: gRPC-ffmpeg
description: Runs Jellyfin's ffmpeg commands on remote grpc-ffmpeg workers.
overview: Offload transcoding, probing and image extraction to grpc-ffmpeg workers, with a local fallback.

versions.changelog:
- Bump grpc-ffmpeg to 8.1.3-8.1
- Integration test: don't count the workers' self-test as a command
- Hardware classes: review fixes
- Bump grpc-ffmpeg to 8.1.3-8.0
- Guard the hardware class registration so it can never cost the relay
- CI: ephemeral-storage requests for all pipeline steps
- CI: pull Docker Hub images through the Harbor proxy
- Hardware classes: hardening, diagnostics and an integration pipeline
- Hardware classes: choose by media, load and reachability ("auto")
- Experimental: per-session hardware classes (Intel QSV + NVIDIA NVENC)

- chore(deps): update dependency crystalnet-org/grpc-ffmpeg to v8.1.3-7.10
- Renovate: keep the CI .NET SDK on the target framework's major version
- Update harbor.crystalnet.org/dockerhub-proxy/renovate/renovate Docker tag to v44.132.1
- Warn while commands fall back to the local ffmpeg; config file created private

- Issue templates and security policy
- Setup check: shared directories, ffmpeg version and overriding environment
- Docs: README for users, building and releases in CONTRIBUTING.md
- README: screenshots of the settings page and the console
- README: Jellyfin 12, sidebar link, switching from a custom image

- Link the settings page in the dashboard sidebar
- Add a plugin image
- release: skip CI for the manifest commit
